clips.kontext_vorher_30s: [Dwarkesh:] … Let's say JPMorgan or Moderna or whatever doesn't want to use them. I've got a country of geniuses. They'll start their own company. If they can't start their own company and they're bottlenecked by clinical trials… [vermutlich Dario:] It is worth stating that with clinical trials, most clinical trials fail because the drug doesn't work. There's not efficacy.
clips.kontext_nachher_30s: [Dwarkesh:] Okay, and then suppose it takes a year for the clinical trials to work out so that you're getting revenue from that and can make more drugs. Okay, well, you've got a country of geniuses and you're an AI lab. You could use many more AI researchers …

clips.speaker: Dario Amodei
clips.source_title: Dario Amodei — "We are near the end of the exponential"
clips.transcript: …AI models are going to greatly accelerate the rate at which we discover drugs, and the pipeline will get jammed up.
clips.transcript_lang: I actually worry more about the drug approval process, where I think AI models are going to greatly accelerate the rate at which we discover drugs, and the pipeline will get jammed up. The pipeline will not be prepared to process all the stuff that's going through it. (01:42:33–01:42:50, 17 s)
clips.slot: Station 6 ~8:00, als Wendung: Er sieht den Engpass selbst. Danach Tafel komplett ✓ ½ ? ✗.
clips.einordnung: And he sees the jam himself. Earlier this year, on the same podcast, he said:
clips.kontext_vorher_30s: My basic view is that if we could decide what laws were passed and how things were done—and we're only one small input into that—I would deregulate a lot of the stuff around the health benefits of AI. I don't worry as much about the chatbot laws. I actually worry more about the drug approval
clips.kontext_nachher_30s: all the stuff that's going through it. I think reform of the regulatory process should bias more towards the fact that we have a lot of things coming where the safety and efficacy is actually going to be really crisp and clear, a beautiful thing, and really effective. Maybe we don't need all this superstructure around it that was designed around an era of drugs that
pruefen: Summe Dwarkesh: C3 8 s + C2 10 s = 18 s ≤ 20 s.
Kontext 'deregulate' fair einordnen: er fordert zugleich mehr Sicherheitsgesetze für KI (01:43:21).
